notes: Fixes in 1.4.14: a magnet download that has finished stays playable after a restart, even when nobody is seeding it anymore. The app no longer shows 'Download finished' or makes numbered extra copies in Downloads every time it starts. Torrents added from a .torrent file are listed by their real name instead of a code, and when a torrent cannot be added the message says why. Finished files the app cannot play get an Open button. Notifications use the right plural and size wording, and a setting that could not be saved is reported instead of closing the app.
